text.en:
Section twenty-seven hundred and fifty-one of the Administrative Code is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"Section 2751. Unlawful destruction of public forest.- It shall be unlawful for any person to make a caingin in
a public forest or in any manner to destroy such forest or part thereof, or forest products growing therein,
otherwise than upon lawful authority. It shall also be unlawful for any person negligently to permit a fire
which has been set
upon his own premises to be communicated, with destructive results, to any public forest. A violation of this
section shall be punished by a fine equivalent to twice the regular Government charges upon the timber or
other forest product so unlawfully destroyed, and subsidiary imprisonment in case of insolvency, or by
imprisonment not exceeding thirty days, or both, in the discretion of the court."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 3, 1926.
